chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad and a number of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, all from al-Wasshaq from Ahmad ibn A'idh from Abu al-Hasan al-Sawwaq from Aban ibn Taghlib from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
O Aban! When you arrive in Kufa, narrate this hadith: 'Whoever testifies that there is no god except Allah, sincerely, Paradise becomes obligatory for him.'
I said to him, 'People of every type come to me. Should I narrate this hadith to all of them?'

He said, 'Yes, O Aban! On the Day of Judgment, when Allah gathers the first and the last, the phrase 'La ilaha illa Allah' will be stripped from them, except for the one who was upon this matter (Wilayah/Imamate).'

key_terms.الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ: The first and the last (of creation)
key_terms.مُخْلِصاً: Sincerely/Making the testimony pure from shirk

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Paradise regarding the testimony of 'La ilaha illa Allah' according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated by Aban ibn Taghlib from Imam al-Sadiq (as), establishes that mere verbal declaration of Tawhid is insufficient for salvation without the accompanying reality of Wilayah. The Imam illustrates this by describing how 'La ilaha illa Allah' will be stripped from the lips of the majority on the Day of Judgment, retaining only for those who remained steadfast upon the specific matter of divine authority. This underscores the Shia theological principle that true monotheism is inextricably linked to recognizing and adhering to the Imams as the rightful successors of the Prophet.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad and a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Al Washha, from Ahmad Bin A’iz, from Abu Al Hassan Al Sawwaq, from Aban Bin Taghlub, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘O Aban!
When you proceed to Al-Kufa, so report this Hadeeth: ‘The one who testifies that there is no god except Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, sincerely, the Paradise would be Obligated for him’.
I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘There would be coming to me from every type (of people) from the types (of people), so shall I report to (all of) them this Hadeeth?’

Heasws said: ‘Yes, O Aban! When it will be the Day of Judgment, and Allahazwj will Gather the former ones and the latter ones, so (the phrase) ‘There is no god except Allahazwj’, would be Confiscated from them except from the one who was upon this matter (Al-Wilyah)’.
en.sarwar: 1. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla ibn Muhammad and A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad all from al- Washsha’ from Ahmad ibn ‘Ai’z from abu al-Hassan al-Sawwaq from Aban ibn Taghlib from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“O Aban, when you will arrive in al-Kufah, narrate this Hadith : ‘Whoever testifies sincerely saying, “No one deserves to be worshipped except Allah,” paradise becomes necessary for him.
I (the narrator) then said, ‘All kinds of people will come to me, shall I narrate it to them?’

The Imam said, ‘Yes, O Aban, when it will be the Day of Judgment and Allah will gather all the people of the past and last together, the testimony: ‘No one deserves to be worshipped except Allah,’ will be taken away from them except those who believe in this cause (belief of the followers of Ahl al-Baay, recipient of divine supreme covenant).”’
